from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

# Case 1: Canonical format with tool_calls key
data = {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'b': 2}}]}
result = ToolCalls.validate_input(data)
print('Case 1 (dict with tool_calls):', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'b': 2}}]}

# Case 2: Single object without tool_calls key
data = {'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}
result = ToolCalls.validate_input(data)
print('Case 2 (single object):', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}

# Case 3: Bare list
data = [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'b': 2}}]
result = ToolCalls.validate_input(data)
print('Case 3 (bare list):', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'b': 2}}]}

# Case 4: JSON string with tool_calls key
data = '{\"tool_calls\": [{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"a\": 1}}]}'
result = ToolCalls.validate_input(data)
print('Case 4 (JSON string with tool_calls):', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}

# Case 5: JSON string single object
data = '{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"a\": 1}}'
result = ToolCalls.validate_input(data)
print('Case 5 (JSON string single object):', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}

# Case 6: JSON string bare list
data = '[{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"a\": 1}}]'
result = ToolCalls.validate_input(data)
print('Case 6 (JSON string bare list):', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}

# Case 7: Non-JSON string
data = 'not valid json at all'
result = ToolCalls.validate_input(data)
print('Case 7 (non-JSON string):', repr(result))
assert result == 'not valid json at all'

# Case 8: ToolCalls instance
instance = ToolCalls(tool_calls=[ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='foo', args={'a': 1})])
result = ToolCalls.validate_input(instance)
print('Case 8 (ToolCalls instance):', result)
assert result == {'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}

print('All cases passed!')
"
